extName.description: Extension name, shown in the toolbar, chrome://extensions and the Web Store. A product name - usually left untranslated.

extDescription.message: Automatically scrolls to the next YouTube Short when the current one finishes playing.
extDescription.description: Extension description, shown in chrome://extensions and the Web Store. Max 132 characters.

popupHeading.description: Heading at the top of the popup. Shorter than extName because the popup is only 300px wide.

toggleLabel.description: Accessible name of the master on/off switch in the popup header. Never shown on screen, only read by screen readers.

statusOn.message: Scrolls to the next Short when this one finishes.
statusOn.description: Text under the heading while the extension is on.

statusOff.description: Text under the heading while the extension is off.

playCountLabel.description: Label for the number input choosing how many times a Short plays before moving on. Followed by the number and playCountUnitOne/Other, reading e.g. "Play each Short  2 times".

playCountUnitOne.description: Unit after the play count when it is exactly 1. Chrome's i18n has no plural rules, so each form is its own message.

playCountUnitOther.description: Unit after the play count when it is 2 or more. See playCountUnitOne.

delayLabel.description: Label for the number input holding the pause between a Short finishing and the scroll.

delayUnit.description: Abbreviation for milliseconds, shown after the delay input.

speedLabel.description: Label for the dropdown choosing playback speed. The options themselves (1x, 1.5x, ...) are numbers and are not translated.

skipSeenLabel.description: Label for the switch that jumps past Shorts already watched. First person, matching the user's point of view.

languageLabel.description: Label for the dropdown choosing the popup's language.

languageAuto.description: First option in the language dropdown: follow whatever language Chrome itself is set to. The other options are language names in their own language and are not translated.
